mechanism.plausibility_rationale: Valproic acid, which possesses this specific multi-target profile (HDAC inhibition, GABA-T inhibition, SSADH inhibition, and sodium channel blockade), is well-documented to cause idiosyncratic hepatotoxicity, ranging from mild asymptomatic transaminase elevation to severe, potentially fatal microvesicular steatosis and hepatic failure.
